name: transcribe
description: Local, open-source meeting notes for macOS. Drop a recording in a folder and get back the transcript, a structured set of notes, and per-meeting folders — without the recording ever leaving your machine.
pipeline: Meeting detection (calendar events + silence gaps + LLM)
Filing (one folder per meeting in destination directory)

modules.cli.py: argument parsing, dispatch, doctor, calendar-check, mic subcommands
modules.audio.py: CoreAudio: which inputs are in use (meeting detection)
modules.autorecord.py: meeting detection state machine, drives OBS via WebSocket
modules.camera.py: CoreMediaIO: which cameras are in use
modules.menubar.py: menu bar app: manual override and signal visibility (rumps)
modules.media.py: ffmpeg/ffprobe: probe, extract audio, lossless video cut
modules.vocabulary.py: assembles the whisper prompt from calendar + mined glossary (224-token budget)
modules.whisper.py: transcription with VAD, timestamped segments, model download
modules.calendars.py: EventKit lookup; registry for future calendar sources
modules.notes.py: notes generation and speaker naming (LLM), apply_corrections feedback loop
modules.llm.py: provider dispatch (Anthropic / OpenAI-compatible), text and schema-constrained calls
modules.links.py: resolves a linkable URL for a destination folder (Drive / iCloud)
modules.gdrive.py: optional Google Drive folder URL resolution
modules.tls.py: TLS CA bundle fixup for frozen binaries

key_settings.destination_directory: One folder per meeting is created here
key_settings.openai_base_url: Point openai provider at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint
key_settings.meeting_mode: Enable meeting splitting and structured notes
key_settings.split_meetings: Detect multiple meetings in one recording

cli_commands: transcribe <file> --no-split      # treat as a single meeting
transcribe <file> --flat          # legacy: one transcript, one summary
transcribe watch <dir>            # watch folder in foreground
transcribe doctor                 # check tools, models, keys, permissions
transcribe calendar-check         # grant/verify macOS Calendar access
transcribe autorecord             # record meetings automatically via OBS
transcribe setup-autorecord       # install auto-record launchd agent
transcribe menubar                # menu bar app with manual override
transcribe mic                    # show inputs, cameras, recording state
output_per_meeting: <meeting>.mov  - lossless video clip for this meeting

ci_workflows.release.yml: publish to PyPI and update Homebrew tap

docs.docs/install.md: install, API keys, Slack, Google Drive, troubleshooting
